summary: Allegro Merger Corp., a blank-check SPAC, filed an 8-K disclosing execution of warrant support agreements for its de-SPAC merger with SeeQC, Inc. Under the agreements, holders of 48.5% of Allegro's outstanding warrants commit to vote for a warrant amendment converting each warrant into one-tenth of a SeeQC common share at closing, and against alternative proposals. The warrant amendment requires 65% approval. Allegro will merge into a SeeQC subsidiary, becoming wholly owned by SeeQC. The merger is subject to SEC registration and stockholder approval. Watch for shareholder vote timing and potential redemptions, which could affect deal financing.
